title: BootstrapRequest

secret.description: The secret from the grant file.

kind.description: The kind of local client exchanging the bootstrap grant: desktop (a new exchange replaces the previous desktop's client session) or tui (several run at once; each is revoked an hour after its connection closed).

label.description: A name for the client session, for people.

description: A local client's exchange of the bootstrap grant's secret for a local client session.
